lessons.observation: TikTok owner reports repeated early departures; CSVs do not provide YouTube swipe-away or Instagram retention. Facebook native average seconds are low in several rows.
lessons.applicability: Test independently truthful, quickly understandable opening concepts inside existing hook/direction review.
limitations: No source establishes a specific first-second cause, narrator defect or editing optimum.
nonGeneralizations: No mandatory question/shock, domain preference or fixed cut frequency.

lessons.observation: Instagram Hotter Pan:1676 Views,1442 Reach,11 Saves,6 Shares,3 Follows; it supplies11 of12 saves in this Lifetime batch.
lessons.applicability: Investigate expectation reversal plus intelligible payoff as a story property; test unfamiliar opportunities on their own merits.
limitations: One post, unmatched exact master, unknown capture age and distribution.
Sharing/saving/following do not prove understanding or loyalty.
nonGeneralizations: No mandate for everyday science, hot-pan clones, palette, duration or narrator.

lessons.observation: YouTube Oklo:60s,42s AVD,66 Views; Traffic35s,24s AVD,1342 Views. Native duration ratios describe engaged averages, not full-watch rates.
lessons.applicability: Audit redundant setup and earned runtime, retaining necessary explanations and qualifications.
limitations: Recent long posts and older shorter posts differ in age/topic/distribution.
nonGeneralizations: No universal maximum or optimal duration; do not turn short-vs-long view totals into causal evidence.

lessons.observation: Craft and Vermeer owner revisions repeatedly required stronger visual progression; existing investigation diagnosed application/feedback-transfer gaps.
lessons.applicability: Apply prior master corrections to consequential visual state changes and separate exact-render editorial review.
limitations: Production-quality lesson, not audience causal proof.
nonGeneralizations: No mandatory animation/3D or rejection of useful static evidence.

lessons.observation: Cycle9 Grenada correction demonstrates proper-name validation and complete-sentence resynthesis needs.
lessons.applicability: Listen to proper names and semantic speech units before exact master handoff; retain primary af_heart and fresh cue/timing bindings.
limitations: No current subjective listening or CSV evidence attributes outcomes to synthetic narration.
nonGeneralizations: No narrator replacement or accent identity copying.

lessons.observation: Prior creator storyboard samples suggest object continuity, demonstrations and explanatory visual metaphors; playback/audio limits remain.
lessons.applicability: First test opening clarity or one same-question explanatory treatment; use retelling accuracy as a guardrail and aligned native snapshots later.
limitations: Internal comparisons are qualitative, not randomized platform A/B tests.
No competing creator performance claims or audiovisual analysis beyond prior recorded inspection.
nonGeneralizations: No proprietary asset/script/audio copying, fixed formula or simultaneous multi-variable attribution.
